title: Trouble at the Yin Puppet Sect's Door
summary: Teng Sha, master of the Yin Puppet Sect, leaves seclusion at Manifestation peak and orders his elders home to break the seal on a treasure the sect took from the ancient tablet. Lin Dong forms Mental Energy Fire, Little Mink takes in the Blood Bat Dragon's demon spirit, and Little Flame condenses a demon spirit of its own. The Ancestral Symbol was taken by the Yin Puppet Sect's master, so Lin Dong goes to the sect in Great Puppet City and calls Teng Lei out. He beats Elder Hua Gu, then holds off Teng Lei's 9th-grade Purple Shadow Nine Breaks and the sect's Yin Puppet Demon Gathering Formation with the Demon Ape Transformation and the new Jade Thunder Body. The fight is a diversion. Little Mink and Little Flame search the sect through a secret passage, but find no word of the Ancestral Symbol. Mu Qianqian and her father Mu Lei come to watch; as they leave, Cao Zhen, a Half-step Manifestation elder, comes out of seclusion.
events: Teng Sha leaves seclusion at Manifestation peak and calls his elders back to break the treasure's seal.
Lin Dong forms Mental Energy Fire; Little Mink glimpses his old human form, and Little Flame condenses a demon spirit.
Lin Dong turns up at the Yin Puppet Sect's gate in Great Puppet City and calls out Teng Lei.
He beats Hua Gu, who wants revenge for his son Hua Zong.
Teng Lei fights with the 9th-grade Purple Shadow Nine Breaks; Lin Dong answers with the Demon Ape Transformation and the Jade Thunder Body.
Teng Lei has his disciples start the Yin Puppet Demon Gathering Formation, and Lin Dong breaks it with his halberd.
Little Mink and Little Flame search a secret passage but find nothing about the Ancestral Symbol.
Mu Qianqian and Mu Lei of the Great Demon Sect watch; Cao Zhen appears at Half-step Manifestation.
cultivation: Teng Sha has reached Manifestation peak. Cao Zhen is Half-step Manifestation. Lin Dong forms Mental Energy Fire and shows the Jade Thunder Body. Little Flame condenses a demon spirit.

Teng Sha's name is written 腾刹 and 滕刹 in different lines; Teng Lei is 腾儡/滕儡 (the official English says 'Teng Kui' several times). I used the wiki names Teng Sha and Teng Lei.
The Yin Puppet Sect's main seat is a separate Yin Puppet City (EP40); this fight is at its branch in Great Puppet City.
Mu Lei is not named this episode (called 宗主 / 爹); EP41 names him 慕雷. Card 831.6 is Mu Qianqian addressing him face to face.
